The packet has only one study showing that failures happen, not how often expectations go unmet. The packet records no counterevidence. The evidence does not settle the frequency claim.

Waymo-linked safety study with data only up to August 2023, in limited service areas. Outside the target period and not about general operation.

reviews.rationale: In November 2023 Cruise's driverless fleet was paused, and Waymo's paid service was confined to a few cities. Nothing in the packet shows dependable general driverless operation. Waymo's bounded service would challenge a narrower 'any commercial use' reading, but not the contextual reading of 'prime time' that the contract adopts.
